# Pinned PDF tools

- pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT), browser dist/pdf-lib.min.js.
- pdfjs-dist 6.5.438 (Apache-2.0), minified browser, worker/renderer and standard-font/WASM support files.
- @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT), optional embedded-font support.

Source: exact npm package tarballs. No user documents or staff data included.
Libraries preserve the original PDF; field positions must be reviewed against
the actual approved master. Tests use fictional synthetic templates only.

Fontkit MIT notice retained from upstream foliojs/fontkit LICENSE; npm fork package declares MIT but omits its license file.
